Job Summary**

Responsible for the efficient and safe operation of process control systems within the LPG feed production facility, ensuring optimal production parameters and product quality for PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk.

Job Responsibilities**

* Monitor and operate distributed control systems (DCS) and supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems for LPG feed processes.
* Analyze process data, trends, and alarms to identify deviations and initiate corrective actions promptly.
* Adjust control parameters (flow rates, temperatures, pressures, levels) to maintain process stability and achieve target production specifications.
* Perform routine checks and inspections of field instruments and equipment to ensure proper functionality.
* Troubleshoot process upsets and collaborate with maintenance teams for timely resolution.
* Record operational data, production logs, and incident reports accurately.
* Adhere to all safety protocols, environmental regulations, and company policies.
* Participate in shift handovers, communicating critical process information and operational status.
* Assist in the startup and shutdown procedures of process units.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives for process optimization and efficiency.

Job Qualifications**

* High school diploma (SMA/SMK) or a bachelor’s degree (S1) in any field.
* Proven experience in operating and monitoring process control systems within the relevant field.
* Strong understanding of feed characteristics, handling procedures, and safety regulations.
* Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to react quickly and effectively in emergency situations.
* High level of attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining workplace safety standards.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Physically fit and capable of working in various environmental conditions, including in confined spaces and at heights, if required.

Ringkasan Pekerjaan:**
Bertanggung jawab untuk memantau dan mengendalikan proses pakan di Feed Lampung guna memastikan operasi yang efisien dan aman, menjaga kualitas produk, serta mematuhi standar dan prosedur perusahaan.

Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan:**
* Mengoperasikan dan memantau sistem kendali proses untuk penerimaan, penyimpanan, dan distribusi di Feed Lampung
* Menyesuaikan parameter proses (misalnya, laju aliran, suhu, tekanan) sesuai kebutuhan untuk menjaga kondisi operasi yang optimal.
* Melakukan pemeriksaan rutin terhadap peralatan dan jaringan pipa untuk mengidentifikasi serta melaporkan adanya malfungsi, kebocoran, atau bahaya keselamatan.
* Melakukan tugas pemeliharaan rutin seperti pembersihan dan perbaikan dasar (*troubleshooting*) pada peralatan kendali proses.
* Mengumpulkan dan menganalisis data proses, serta memelihara catatan dan laporan kinerja operasional yang akurat.
* Menanggapi alarm dan penyimpangan dengan segera, serta menerapkan tindakan perbaikan untuk mencegah gangguan dan memastikan keselamatan.
* Bekerja sama dengan tim pemeliharaan dan produksi untuk mengoordinasikan penghentian (*shutdown*), penyalaan (*startup*), dan aktivitas operasional lainnya.
* Memastikan kepatuhan ketat terhadap protokol keselamatan, peraturan lingkungan, dan standar pengendalian mutu.
* Berpartisipasi dalam program pelatihan untuk meningkatkan pengetahuan tentang teknologi kendali proses dan prosedur keselamatan.

Kualifikasi Pekerjaan:**
* SMA/SMK, S1 semua jurusan
* Memiliki pengalaman terbukti dalam mengoperasikan dan memantau sistem kendali proses/ di bidangnya.
* Memiliki pemahaman yang kuat mengenai karakteristik pakan, prosedur penanganan, dan peraturan keselamatan.
* Memiliki kemampuan pemecahan masalah yang sangat baik serta kemampuan untuk bereaksi secara cepat dan efektif dalam situasi darurat.
* Memiliki ketelitian yang tinggi dan komitmen untuk menjaga standar keselamatan kerja
* Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan kerja sama tim yang baik.
* Sehat secara fisik dan mampu bekerja dalam berbagai kondisi lingkungan, termasuk di ruang terbatas dan ketinggian, jika diperlukan.

Kirim lamaran (CV, Ijazah, KTP, Transkrip Nilai, KK, sertifikat pendukung lainnya)
Jadikan 1 PDF dan apply ke :
PT JAPFA COMFEED INDONESIA, TBK
UNIT LAMPUNG

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

wo-klbf-JR26_001835.d:
Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Develop and maintain client relationships.
- Execute sales plan of actions as deployed from superior on monthly and quarterly basis (include plan of customer visit, expenses, sales target per outlet/customer, etc).

- Mengembangkan dan mempertahankan hubungan dengan klien.
- Melaksanakan rencana aksi penjualan yang diberikan oleh atasan secara bulanan dan triwulanan (termasuk rencana kunjungan pelanggan, pengeluaran, target penjualan per outlet/pelanggan, dll).

Company:
KF PT. Kalbe Farma Tbk.
